item.makeshiftrifledsc: Simple and convenient. Uses 5.56mm rifle rounds
item.nf.glock18dsc: A select-fire 9mm handgun. Functionaly it's exaclty like glock 17 but with option for full-auto and a laser attachment. Can only fit small magazines
item.nf.hipointdsc: An old, small, magazine-feed 9mm handgun. Would do well in combat. Can only fit m1911 magazines
item.nf.m16dsc: Quite famous rifle from other planet. Uses standard 5.56mm rifle rounds
item.nf.makeshiftpistoldsc: A crude basic handgun, holds two 9mm rounds in chambers. Doesn't have safety. Won't last for a long. Consider switching to more capable firearms in case of combat
item.nf.mp5dsc: A stocked select-fire submachine gun. Can fit small magazines or SMG magazines
item.nf.p90dsc: A 9mm bullpup submachine gun, uses specialized P90 magazines.
item.nf.sawedoffdsc: An level-action shotgun with cutoff barrels, only holds 2 rounds. Can be loaded with any 12-gauge round
item.nf.semiautoshotgundsc: A Semi-automatic tube-feed shotgun, it is clearly handmade. Can be loaded with any 12gauge shells
item.nf.uzidsc: A full-auto 9mm submachine gun. The recoil is rather, unplessant. Can fit small magazines or SMG magazines
item.nf.vectordsc: An 9mm selct-fire submachine gun with a special recoil-reduction mechanism and a low fire rate. Can only fit smg magazines
item.pistoldsc: A common 9mm semi-auto handgun. You remember your capitors carrying it back on Earth. Can only fit small magazines.
item.shotgundsc: A generic unbranded tube-feed pump-action shotgun, can be loaded with any 12gauge shell.
item.boxof12gaugedsc: A box for storing 12guage rounds. Holds 16 rounds
item.nf.boxof556dsc: A box for storing 5.56mm rounds. Holds 24 rounds
item.nf.boxof9mmdsc: An box made to hold up to thirty-two 9mm round. Use to remove round
item.nf.grenadedsc: A projectile for use in grenade launcher TODO
item.nf.hipointmagdsc: A handgun magazine. Can hold up to eight 9mm rounds in it
item.nf.p90magdsc: A magazine for P90. Holds 50 9mm rounds
item.nf.saigamagdsc: A magazine for a shotgun named Saiga. Holds 10 of any kind 12gauge rounds
item.nf.smgmagdsc: An magazine for use in subamchine guns. Can hold up to thirty 9mm rounds
item.riflemagazinedsc: A magazine for most rifles, simple enough to be hand made or mass produced. Holds up to 25 5.56mm rifle rounds
item.smallmagazinedsc: An handgun magazine. Can hold up to seventeen 9mm rounds in it
item.nf.12gaugebirddsc: An variation of 12gauge with more pellets and higher spread. Can be loaded into shotguns, or directly into the chamber if the gun's bolt is open.
item.nf.12gaugeslugdsc: An variation of 12gauge with only one big pellet. Can be loaded into shotguns, or directly into the chamber if the gun's bolt is open
item.nf.556piercingdsc: Armor-piercing variant of rifle round. Can be loaded into a rifle magazine, or directly into the chamber if the gun's bolt is open.
item.nf.9mmhollowdsc: An variation of 9mm round with hollow points, deals more damage against living targets, but not as penetrating. Can be loaded into magazines, or directly into the chamber if the gun's bolt is open.
item.nf.9mmvenomusdsc: An variation of 9mm round with venomus points, deals toxicosis against living targets, but not as penetrating. Can be loaded into magazines, or directly into the chamber if the gun's bolt is open.

other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.intro: Welcome to firearm handling. First of all, lets pin first aid knowledge
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.medical: You know how to treat it.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.medicalCompl: Good job Experiment #{0}, now, lets move on to when you are the one firing
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.rack: Pick up the M1911. Open the slide by dragging its handle in the gun window. With the minigame disabled, use the configured rack control. An open slide is not a loaded chamber.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.insert: A loaded magazine is in your front pouch or beside you. Drag it onto the weapon. Close the slide to chamber a round. Loose rounds belong in the bandolier; spare magazines belong in the front pouch.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.eject: Now eject the magazine using the magazine-release area, or your configured eject control. A chambered round can remain after the magazine is removed.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.reinsert: Reinsert a magazine. If the slide is locked open, close it. If it is closed on an empty chamber, cycle it. Check the fire selector: safe will prevent firing.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.looseRound: An empty spare magazine and loose 9mm rounds are supplied. Drag a round from the bandolier onto that magazine, or combine them in inventory. Load at least one round to continue.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.range: Moving to the firing range. Training ammunition will be replenished during targets and live practice. Injuries carry through training; you receive one full recovery immediately before survival.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.targets: Practice with {0}. Load, chamber, select a firing mode, then destroy all three targets to your right. Other weapons do not count for this drill. Reload whenever necessary.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.combat: Live practice: three waves. Clear each wave before the next. Ammo is replenished, but there is no automatic healing between waves.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.survival: Training complete. You will receive one full recovery and a finite stock of guns and ammunition. No resupply, automatic healing, or medical equipment after that. Enemies keep arriving. Your score is active survival time; pauses do not count. Leave the course whenever you wish.

other.newfirearms.command.reload.description: Reload a gun's JSON, sprites and audio from disk: nf_reload [id] [--destroy]. --destroy removes existing guns to allow structural changes. Single-player only. May corrupt your save! For development use only. Restart the game afterwards
other.newfirearms.command.reload.usage: Usage: nf_reload [registered gun id] [--destroy]. Without an id, hold a NewFirearms gun in your leading hand.
other.newfirearms.command.reload.structure: Live guns require the same feedType, internalCapacity, ammo IDs/order, magazineType, hasLaser and needRetract. Use --destroy to remove existing guns and apply structural changes.
other.newfirearms.command.reload.destroyed: Reimported {0}; destroyed {1} existing gun(s), including their loaded ammunition. Spawn a new instance to test the new structure.
other.newfirearms.command.reload.success: Reimported {0}; refreshed {1} existing gun(s). Audio finishes loading asynchronously.
